channel.niche: original cinematic pop and alternative music with lyric videos — songs about love, heartbreak, hope, and personal transformation
channel.audience: listeners who discover new independent artists through emotionally resonant, story-driven songs — people drawn to lyric videos and cinematic production over generic pop
channel.brandVoice: emotional, cinematic, intimate — metadata should feel like it belongs to a song, not a generic upload. No hype language, no clickbait. Lean into the actual feeling/story of each track.
